method: Each listed item ID was injected into a temporary WRAM slot and captured separately from an actual Snes9x render of the SHA-1-identified Thai V1.2 patched ROM. Label images preserve the ROM's exact rendered spelling. Identical image hashes may establish visually identical captures, but Japanese names are not used to infer Thai labels. No ROM, patch, save state, or memory dump is included. Bait IDs are listed with Japanese fallback only because the attempted capture route yielded identical screenshots for all IDs; no bait Thai name is claimed. Hook and float/sinker entries are listed with Japanese fallback only; no verified Thai ROM label crops were captured for them.
captureType: per-item rendered label crop; Unicode name only when verified independently
